requirements.summary: Render the existing NetflixTop10 section in the homepage main flow and wire it to the shared media click handler.
acceptanceCriteria: On the homepage, a Netflix-specific section is visible without requiring login.
The Netflix section is rendered using the existing `frontend/src/components/NetflixTop10.tsx` component and appears in the main `<main>` content flow (alongside Featured and Trending sections).
Clicking an item inside the Netflix section triggers the same trailer/open behavior as other media sections (i.e., uses the same `onMediaClick` handler wiring as other rows/grids).

file_operations.description: Import and render the existing `NetflixTop10` component within the homepage `<main>` flow (near `FeaturedRow` and `ContentGrid`) and pass the shared `handleMediaClick` as `onMediaClick` so trailer/open behavior matches other sections.

requirements.summary: Make the Netflix section header explicitly identify Netflix in both loading and loaded states and keep it visually distinct/readable on dark/glass backgrounds.
acceptanceCriteria: The Netflix section header includes clear English text that explicitly names Netflix (for example: “Netflix Top 10” or “Top 10 on Netflix”), not just “Top 10”.
The Netflix label is present in both loading and loaded states of the Netflix section.

The Netflix section remains visually distinct from other sections via its header block (e.g., Netflix logo + explicit Netflix text, consistent spacing), without reducing readability on dark/glass backgrounds.

file_operations.description: Update the section header text in both loading and loaded render paths to explicitly include the word "Netflix" (e.g., "Netflix Top 10" / "Top 10 on Netflix"), while retaining the existing logo asset at `frontend/public/assets/generated/netflix-logo-transparent.dim_200x100.png` and ensuring header styling remains distinct and readable on dark/glass backgrounds.
